resources.string: Nika SmartKey is made for smartphones with buttons and a touch screen. It has: the usual TalkBack gestures; quick keys and volume keys with assignable actions; macros; voice commands; a translator; scripts; a help mode where pressing a key tells what it does; answering and ending calls. It does not have: the agent, iPhone-style gestures, the side and circular menus, the power button feature, three and four finger gestures.
